description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different source types—Tutorials (blue circles), Library Documentation (red circles), StackOverflow posts (yellow circles), and Github files (green circles)—as a function of chunk size, measured in number of tokens along the x-axis, which ranges from 200 to 1000 in increments of 200. The y-axis, labeled implicitly as performance (though unlabeled), spans from 10 to 40 in increments of 10. Tutorials show a generally increasing trend from approximately 23 at 200 tokens to 29 at 800 tokens, then slightly dip to 28 at 1000 tokens. Library Documentation starts at 26, rises to 32 at 800 tokens, and falls to 27 at 1000 tokens. Github files begin at 28, climb steadily to 33 at 800 tokens, and decline slightly to 30 at 1000 tokens. In contrast, StackOverflow posts start at 33, drop sharply to 19 at 800 tokens, and fall further to 11 at 1000 tokens, showing a strong negative correlation with increasing token count. All lines are connected with solid lines and marked with circular data points.
